messages.text: Beirne captains strong Ireland selection vs Fiji as Gibson-Park returns

metadata.summary: Tadhg Beirne will captain a strong Ireland selection vs Fiji in the Nations Championship on Saturday, despite head coach Andy Farrell making seven changes.
metadata.content: Nations Championship: Tadhg Beirne captains strong Ireland selection vs Fiji as Jamison Gibson-Park returns, Rob Baloucoune passed fit | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Nations Championship: Tadhg Beirne captains strong Ireland selection vs Fiji as Jamison Gibson-Park returns, Rob Baloucoune passed fit Andy Farrell's Ireland host Fiji at Aviva Stadium, Dublin on Saturday in Nations Championship (8.10pm); team selection shows seven changes to thumping win vs Argentina as Jamison Gibson-Park, Tommy O'Brien, Bundee Aki, Jamie Osborne, Ronan Kelleher, James Ryan, Josh van der Flier come in Michael Cantillon Sports Journalist Thursday 12 November 2026 14:22, UK Image: Tadhg Beirne will captain Ireland on Saturday as they host Fiji in the Nations Championship Tadhg Beirne will captain a strong Ireland selection vs Fiji in the Nations Championship on Saturday, despite head coach Andy Farrell making seven changes. Two of those changes are enforced as hooker Dan Sheehan (concussion) and No 8 Sean Jansen (knee) were ruled out, but several other injury concerns have been allayed. Indeed, wing Rob Baloucoune is fit to start again, as is Mack Hansen despite an ankle knock - the latter shifting to full-back with Hugo Keenan rested and Tommy O'Brien brought into the back-three. Josh van der Flier is also fit despite his own ankle complaint, starting at openside flanker with Nick Timoney shifting to No 8 in the absence of Jansen, Jack Conan and Caelan Doris due to injury.

metadata.summary: Crystal Palace have sacked manager Pierre Sage after just 16 matches.
metadata.content: Pierre Sage: Crystal Palace sack manager with club bottom of Premier League table after 10 matches | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Pierre Sage: Crystal Palace sack manager with club bottom of Premier League table after 10 matches Pierre Sage was appointed by Crystal Palace in the summer on a three-year contract, replacing Oliver Glasner; the former Lyon and Lens boss won just two of his 10 Premier League games in charge and the Eagles sit bottom of the table; Palace working to bring in Thomas Frank as replacement Thursday 12 November 2026 13:52, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports chief correspondent Kaveh Solhekol explains why Crystal Palace have sacked Pierre Sage and who is likely to replace him. Crystal Palace have sacked manager Pierre Sage after just 16 matches. Sage, appointed in June on a three-year contract to replace Oliver Glasner, leaves with Palace bottom of the Premier League table after winning just two of his 10 league matches in charge. Palace are working on a deal to bring in Thomas Frank as his replacement. The Dane has been out of work since he was sacked as Tottenham boss in February. metadata.summary: Henry Pollock, Max Ojomoh and Will Joseph will all start for England in Saturday's Nations Championship Test vs Japan as part of 10 changes.
metadata.content: Nations Championship: Henry Pollock, Max Ojomoh, Will Joseph start for England vs Japan as part of 10 changes | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Nations Championship: Henry Pollock, Max Ojomoh, Will Joseph start for England vs Japan as part of 10 changes England vs Japan at Twickenham on Saturday in Nations Championship Test (4.40pm); Steve Borthwick makes 10 changes to starting XV; Henry Pollock, Max Ojomoh, Will Joseph, Ellis Genge, Luke Cowan-Dickie, Asher Opoku-Fordjour, George Martin, George Ford, Cadan Murley, Freddie Steward all in Michael Cantillon Sports Journalist Thursday 12 November 2026 16:19, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Japan head coach Eddie Jones has fired England a warning to 'expect the unorthodox' ahead of their reunion with their former coach Henry Pollock, Max Ojomoh and Will Joseph will all start for England in Saturday's Nations Championship Test vs Japan as part of 10 changes. Fresh from his two-try impact off the bench - out of position on the wing - Pollock is named to start at No 8 by head coach Steve Borthwick. Despite his huge impact to date, Saturday will only be the second time in 15 Tests Pollock starts. Ojomoh comes in for his first cap in a year to start at inside-centre with Seb Atkinson out injured (hip), while Joseph replaces Tommy Freeman on the right wing in his first England appearance since July 2022. metadata.content: Racing Bulls confirm Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad as 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Update Racing Bulls confirm Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad as 2027 Formula 1 driver line-up After weeks of speculation, Liam Lawson's future at Racing Bulls is secure for 2027; Lawson to again partner British youngster Arvid Lindblad; Nikola Tsolov named Red Bull teams' reserve driver; watch the Las Vegas GP weekend live on Sky Sports F1 from November 20-22 Thursday 12 November 2026 15:27, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Liam Lawson teams up with Sky Sports F1's Simon Lazenby and Naomi Schiff to prank Racing Bulls team-mate Arvid Lindblad with a fake interview Racing Bulls have confirmed Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad will be retained for the 2027 Formula 1 season. Lawson's future appeared to be in doubt earlier this month as Racing Bulls and parent team Red Bull pondered whether to replace the New Zealander with Formula 2 championship contender Nikola Tsolov. But Lawson has retained his seat for next year, with three races left in what has comfortably been his best season in F1 so far. Tsolov has been named as reserve driver for both Red Bull-owned teams.
